mechanisms.definition: Parametric constant-exponent family |x/a|^n + |y/b|^n = 1 with explicit sign restoration.
mechanisms.formula: x=a*sgn(cos t)|cos t|^(2/n); y=b*sgn(sin t)|sin t|^(2/n)
mechanisms.integration: Pattern primitive; may define support, route boundary or swept profile.

mechanisms.definition: Bounded radial pattern grammar that generalizes circles, polygons, stars and lobed forms.
mechanisms.integration: Versioned parameter tuple; denominator floor prevents singular numerical blow-up.

mechanisms.definition: Polar harmonic petal pattern with integer or rational angular frequency.
mechanisms.integration: Periodic support/template; winding and event surfaces remain separately typed.

mechanisms.definition: Two-axis harmonic pattern with declared frequencies and phase offset.
mechanisms.formula: x=A sin(a t+delta); y=B sin(b t)
mechanisms.integration: Kinematic test path, phase compatibility probe or calibration trajectory.

mechanisms.definition: Point attached to a circle rolling outside another circle.
mechanisms.formula: x=(R+r)cos t-d cos((R+r)t/r); y=(R+r)sin t-d sin((R+r)t/r)
mechanisms.integration: Closed periodic route when radius ratio is rational; otherwise bounded quasi-periodic sample.

mechanisms.definition: Point attached to a circle rolling inside another circle.
mechanisms.formula: x=(R-r)cos t+d cos((R-r)t/r); y=(R-r)sin t-d sin((R-r)t/r)
mechanisms.integration: Pattern route with cusp/self-intersection events classified by derivative and sheet.

mechanisms.definition: Trace of a point on a circle rolling along a line.
mechanisms.integration: Exact benchmark trajectory for cusp and contact events.

mechanisms.definition: Rolling-circle trace with point offset d distinct from radius r.
mechanisms.formula: x=r t-d sin t; y=r-d cos t
mechanisms.integration: Prolate/curtate transition controlled by d/r and classified at d=r.

mechanisms.definition: Taut-string unwrapping curve with monotonic arc parameter.
mechanisms.formula: x=r(cos t+t sin t); y=r(sin t-t cos t)
mechanisms.integration: Gear/contact profile and nonuniform curvature benchmark.

mechanisms.definition: Static hanging-chain profile retained as a bounded mechanical shape, not a generic parabola.
mechanisms.integration: Constraint shape or potential-energy equilibrium reference.

mechanisms.definition: Curve whose curvature changes linearly with arc length.
mechanisms.integration: Curvature-continuous route connector and steering transition.

mechanisms.definition: Square-root radial spiral with explicit branch sign.
mechanisms.integration: Two-arm address pattern and bounded sample schedule.

mechanisms.definition: Linear radial growth under angular phase.
mechanisms.integration: Uniform shell-crossing benchmark and address sweep.

mechanisms.definition: Three control points with middle weight representing exact conic arcs under valid weights.
mechanisms.integration: Conic-support primitive with denominator guard and schema-bound weight.

mechanisms.definition: Four-point polynomial curve with endpoint tangent control.
mechanisms.integration: Glyph morph, route segment and local sweep centerline.

mechanisms.definition: Piecewise polynomial curve with local control and declared degree/knot vector.
mechanisms.integration: Finite grammar output normalized to bounded control points and degree.

mechanisms.definition: Rational B-spline with explicit positive weights and knot vector.
mechanisms.formula: C(t)=sum_i N_i,p w_i P_i / sum_i N_i,p w_i
mechanisms.integration: Exact/approximate CAD-style route with denominator and weight validation.

mechanisms.definition: Three circular arcs producing a convex constant-width curve.
mechanisms.formula: Boundary assembled from radius-w arcs centered at equilateral-triangle vertices.
mechanisms.integration: Constant-clearance support profile and rotation benchmark.

mechanisms.definition: Nearest-site partition generalized by additive site weights.
mechanisms.integration: Compatibility/routing partition compiled to local candidate tests.

mechanisms.definition: Centerline candidates derived from equal-distance pairs or sampled boundary normals.
mechanisms.integration: Compressed shape skeleton; approximation status and sampling density are logged.

mechanisms.definition: Exponent-controlled 3D generalization of ellipsoids and box-like rounded solids.
mechanisms.integration: Implicit event/support field; not automatically an exact Euclidean SDF.

mechanisms.definition: Quadratic form with positive scales or covariance-like metric.
mechanisms.formula: f(x)=x^T A x-1, A positive definite
mechanisms.integration: Directional guard/support with explicit metric and conditioning checks.

mechanisms.definition: Distance-to-centerline field minus radius using a sampled or analytic curve.
mechanisms.integration: Cable, vessel, wormhole-route visualization or collision support; sampled error is declared.

mechanisms.definition: Cross-section transported along a centerline with an explicit moving frame.
mechanisms.integration: Pattern extrusion using Frenet or Bishop frame; frame choice is schema-bound.

mechanisms.definition: Surface formed by linearly connecting corresponding points on two curves.
mechanisms.integration: Portal sheet, transition membrane or developable approximation.

mechanisms.definition: Ruled minimal-surface family generated by screw motion.
mechanisms.formula: X(u,v)=(v cos u,v sin u,p u)
mechanisms.integration: Screw-symmetry route/sheet example; physical minimality is not assumed in discrete realization.

mechanisms.definition: Surface of revolution of a catenary.
mechanisms.integration: Neck/pinch geometry with finite guard and no singular-energy claim.

mechanisms.definition: Triply periodic implicit pattern used as a bounded field template.
mechanisms.formula: sin x cos y + sin y cos z + sin z cos x = c
mechanisms.integration: Periodic support/route field; topology depends on threshold and finite domain.

mechanisms.definition: Triply periodic cosine field serving as a connected-sheet template.
mechanisms.integration: Field grammar primitive with threshold and cell count explicitly bounded.

mechanisms.definition: Smooth influence-field combination with explicit compact or inverse-distance kernel.
mechanisms.integration: Merge/split event benchmark; kernel support and saturation are declared.

mechanisms.definition: Parallel-set transform expressed as a field offset when the input is distance-like.
mechanisms.integration: Guard expansion, tolerance shell and manufacturing clearance; exact only for valid distance fields.

mechanisms.definition: Arrival-time field under a declared local propagation speed.
mechanisms.integration: Event-time support primitive; variable-speed solver is specified separately.

mechanisms.definition: Integer-valued enclosure/orientation descriptor for closed planar routes.
mechanisms.integration: Inside/outside and route class metadata without collapsing geometry to a bit.

mechanisms.definition: Unwrapped coordinate retains traversal count across periodic quotient boundaries.
mechanisms.integration: Prevents ambiguity at repeated coordinates and supports lineage reconstruction.

mechanisms.definition: Route label stores obstacle winding/signature rather than only endpoint coordinates.
mechanisms.integration: Compatibility and branch selection may require matching or allowed classes.

mechanisms.definition: Ordered crossings represented by generators sigma_i and inverses with local cancellation.
mechanisms.integration: Multi-entity route lineage; word length is bounded and reduction policy explicit.

mechanisms.definition: Optional low-cost invariant or numerical linking estimate for closed route pairs.
mechanisms.formula: Gauss linking integral or declared discrete approximation
mechanisms.integration: Diagnostic checksum only; not complete knot identity and not used as sole authority.

mechanisms.definition: Vertices, edges, faces and cells connected through oriented incidence maps.
mechanisms.integration: Topology storage independent of embedding; supports local gluing and route updates.

mechanisms.definition: Topology transition updates primal incidence and dual cochain state consistently.
mechanisms.integration: Validation rejects edits violating boundary-of-boundary zero.

mechanisms.definition: Cell pairing identifies local critical cells where topology/routing may change.
mechanisms.formula: Unpaired cells are critical under a declared matching.
mechanisms.integration: Event candidate for simplification or handle birth/death; matching is explicit.

mechanisms.definition: Birth/death intervals summarize bounded filtration changes.
mechanisms.integration: Diagnostic feature vector; does not replace full geometry or lineage.
mechanisms.validation: Specified exchange format; solver not bundled

mechanisms.definition: Overlapping chart maps are checked for consistent composition.
mechanisms.formula: g_ij g_jk = g_ik on triple overlaps
mechanisms.integration: Prevents incompatible portal/gluing definitions in multi-chart worlds.

mechanisms.definition: Planar position/orientation update represented by the exponential of a body twist.
mechanisms.integration: Exact constant-twist state_at(t) and portal patch primitive.

mechanisms.definition: Spatial rigid motion generated by angular and linear velocity.
mechanisms.formula: T=exp([omega,v]^ t) with Rodrigues rotation and V matrix
mechanisms.integration: Constant screw motion, frame transport and analytic state query.

mechanisms.definition: Shortest-arc interpolation of unit orientations with antipodal handling.
mechanisms.formula: q(t)=sin((1-t)theta)/sin theta q0 + sin(t theta)/sin theta q1
mechanisms.integration: Orientation interpolation separate from position and topology.

mechanisms.definition: Interpolate through the relative rigid transform log/exponential rather than independent Euler angles.
mechanisms.integration: Portal/coupler motion with consistent rotation-translation coupling.

mechanisms.definition: Tangent, normal and binormal derived from nondegenerate curve derivatives.
mechanisms.formula: T=r'/|r'|; B=(r' x r'')/|r' x r''|; N=B x T
mechanisms.integration: Curvature/torsion diagnostics and sweep orientation where curvature is nonzero.

mechanisms.definition: Rotation-minimizing frame transported along a sampled curve.
mechanisms.formula: Project previous normal into new tangent plane, then renormalize.
mechanisms.integration: Stable sweep frame through near-zero-curvature segments.

mechanisms.definition: Monotone lookup maps path parameter to cumulative distance and back.
mechanisms.integration: Uniform-speed queries and event bracketing with declared interpolation error.

mechanisms.definition: Speed and angular rate constrained by path curvature and lateral acceleration.
mechanisms.integration: Feasible trajectory gate before event solving.

mechanisms.definition: Endpoint-rest time law with continuous position, velocity and acceleration.
mechanisms.integration: Smooth phase/route actuation; peak derivatives determine duration contract.

mechanisms.definition: Choose trajectory duration so normalized velocity, acceleration and jerk stay within declared limits.
mechanisms.integration: Bounded schedule; not claimed globally time-optimal for arbitrary paths.

mechanisms.definition: Compose joint transforms to obtain link and endpoint frames.
mechanisms.integration: Finite grammar may emit link chains; state query returns all frames and lineage.

mechanisms.definition: Regularized local inverse step avoids singular matrix blow-up.
mechanisms.integration: Optional solver with residual, iteration budget and failure status.

mechanisms.definition: Velocity is updated before position for improved qualitative energy behavior in separable mechanics.
mechanisms.integration: Fallback dynamic state update; timestep and error budget remain explicit.

mechanisms.definition: Mass-spring-damper evolution with typed mass, stiffness and damping.
mechanisms.integration: Actuator, hinge or threshold reset dynamics; energy bookkeeping is measurable.

mechanisms.definition: Local state exchange over an explicit adjacency graph.
mechanisms.formula: x'=-alpha L x or x''+C x'+Kx=0
mechanisms.integration: Phase smoothing, consensus or coupled oscillation without hidden global field.

mechanisms.definition: Two-field local reaction plus diffusion update on a bounded grid or graph.
mechanisms.formula: Gray-Scott: U_t=D_u Lap U-UV^2+F(1-U); V_t=D_v Lap V+UV^2-(F+k)V
mechanisms.integration: Dynamic pattern generator kept downstream of typed field/state schema.

mechanisms.definition: Each mode has a continuous flow; guard crossings invoke discrete reset and route changes.
mechanisms.integration: Generalizes threshold cup, parity hinge and event transition into a typed model.

mechanisms.definition: Classify crossing, tangency and coincidence; resolve equal-time patches by priority or verified commutativity.
mechanisms.formula: Use sign history, derivative, residual interval and patch-conflict graph.
mechanisms.integration: Prevents chatter, unordered lineage and silent overwrite at multi-guard events.
